_comment: Not a recording: the synthetic library tools/e2e/kit.py generates and seeds into the e2e BookOrbit server (docs/design/emulated-release-tests.md stage 0). Every name is invented. Books are numbered in this order: each series in turn, then the standalones. A book's file is the same on every run (fixed timestamps), so its KOReader partial MD5 is too.

roles._comment: Books scenarios use by role; kit.py rewrite <role> makes BookOrbit write its metadata into the file, which changes the file's hash.
